newsitem.title: USA: Belknap in talks on phone contract.
newsitem.headline: Belknap in talks on phone contract.

text.p: Belknap Corp Friday said it entered into preliminary negotiations to install, operate and maintain a complete telecommunications system in one of the regions of the Russian Federation.

In a statement, the company said the system will include telephones -- both stationary and mobile -- paging, data transmissions, voice mail, video conferencing with worldwide capability, Internet access, banking systems with automatic electronic transfers capabilities, public telephones with debit or pre-paid card capabilities, and alarm systems for local government, commercial and residential customers.

In addition to the standard communications services, Belknap said it will offer a range of Personal Emergency Communications Services based on proprietary technology such as warning subscribers of possible danger areas, vehicle theft prevention, silent alarms in case of unauthorized use of vehicles, warning of approaching emergency vehicles at high speeds, monitoring and tracking of valuable cargo and other specialized services.

The company said a possible start of 20,000 subscribers is being negotiated and the company anticipates the equipment will be supplied by leading U.S. manufacturers of digital wireless networks and a full range of supporting equipment based on the latest communication technologies.

In addition to the local calls, Belknap said it expects to connect the region to the rest of the world working together with established international long distance carriers with satellite connections capabilities.
The company said it expects to complete the negotiations within the next six months. Subject to the results of the negotiations, a full disclosure will be made available.
